hq_location.notes: The company leadership page gives a Redwood City, California address; LinkedIn also identifies Redwood City as headquarters.

public_docs.notes: The public Support/Solutions site has multiple articles, including release notes and support materials.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest located funding announcement is October 8, 2025, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025? Correction: October 8, 2025 falls inside that window, so the correct answer is true.

founded_year.notes: Company profile sources list 2010 as the founding year.

last_funding.notes: Vistara announced a US$12 million investment on October 8, 2025; funding sources identify it as debt financing.

launched_6mo.notes: The July 9, 2026 Silo Marketplace announcement is a product feature launch within the six-month window. The September 2026 release page also records a feature update.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists plans and per-user annual prices.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn reports 124 employees as of September 30, 2026; that falls within 101-200.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page’s indexed open positions include Sales Development Representative, Commercial.

model_provider.notes: The AI information page says Silo Nexus AI uses public AI models, but no particular model provider is identified as the product’s provider. Its mentions of ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity are in the context of explaining the public AI information page, not an explicit declaration that these power the product.

named_customers.notes: ICANN is expressly named in the published customer case study. Other success-story titles reviewed were anonymized, so only one customer name could be verified.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page linked to open positions but showed no current AI, ML, or data-science role titles.

compliance_certs.notes: These five named items appear on the certifications page; other named certifications were omitted because the requested list is limited to these categories.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The reviewed public careers, docs, and integration pages did not identify a CRM or sales/marketing system in accessible text.

product_one_liner.notes: Product description and intended user groups are stated on the product page.
product_one_liner.value: Authentic8’s Silo Workspace is a cloud-based platform for secure, anonymous digital investigations, built for investigators and analysts in areas such as cyber threat intelligence, OSINT, fraud, financial crime, corporate security, and law enforcement.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The leadership page lists current executives but does not establish when they joined or whether any executive departure occurred during the 12-month window; no verifiable dated change was found.
